ayahs.3: Isi ne insaan ko paida kiya.
ayahs.5: Aaftaab aur maahtaab (muqarrara) hisaab se hain.
ayahs.6: Aur sitaare aur darakht dono sajda karte hain.
ayahs.7: Isi ne aasman ko buland kiya aur isi ne taraazu rakhi.
ayahs.8: Taake tum tolne mein tajaawuz na karo.
ayahs.9: Insaaf ke saath wazan ko theek rakho aur tol mein kam na do.
ayahs.10: Aur isi ne makhlooq ke liye zameen bichha di.
ayahs.11: Jis mein meway hain aur khoshay wale khajoor ke darakht hain.
ayahs.12: Aur bhoos wala anaaj hai. Aur khushboodaar phool hain.
ayahs.13: Pas (ae insaano aur jinno!) Tum apne Parwardigaar ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.14: Is ne insaan ko bajne wali mitti se paida kiya jo theekri ki tarah thi.
ayahs.15: Aur jinnat ko aag ke shole se paida kiya.
ayahs.16: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.17: Woh Rabb hai dono mashriqon aur dono maghribon ka.
ayahs.18: To (ae jinno aur insaano!) Tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.19: Is ne do darya jaari kar diye jo ek doosre se mil jaate hain.
ayahs.20: Un dono mein ek aad hai ke is se badh nahin sakte.
ayahs.21: Pas apne Parwardigaar ki kaun kaun si ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.22: Un dono mein se moti aur moonge baraamad hote hain.
ayahs.23: Phir tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.24: Aur Allah hi ki (milkiyat mein) hain woh jahaaz jo samundaron mein pahaad ki tarah buland (chal phir rahe) hain.
ayahs.25: Pas (ae insaano aur jinno!) Tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.26: Zameen par jo hain sab fana hone wale hain.
ayahs.27: Sirf tere Rabb ki zaat jo azmat aur izzat wali hai baaqi reh jaayegi.
ayahs.28: Phir tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.29: Sab aasman-o-zameen wale isi se maangte hain. Har roz woh ek shaan mein hai.
ayahs.30: Phir tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.31: (Jinnon aur insaanon ke giroho!) Anqareeb hum tumhari taraf poori tarah mutawajjeh ho jaayenge.
ayahs.32: Phir tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.33: Ae giroh-e-jinnat-o-insaan! Agar tum mein aasmanon aur zameen ke kinaaron se baahar nikal jaane ki taaqat hai to nikal bhaago! Baghair ghalba aur taaqat ke tum nahin nikal sakte.
ayahs.34: Phir tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.35: Tum par aag ke shole aur dhuan chhoda jaayega phir tum muqaabla na kar sakoge.
ayahs.36: Phir apne Rabb ki ne'maton mein se kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.37: Pas jabke aasman phat kar surkh ho jaaye jaise ke surkh chamda.
ayahs.38: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.39: Is din kisi insaan aur kisi jinn se is ke gunaahon ki pursish na ki jaayegi.
ayahs.40: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.41: Gunaahgaar sirf huliya hi se pehchaan liye jaayenge aur un ki peshaniyon ke baal aur qadam pakad liye jaayenge.
ayahs.42: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.43: Yeh hai woh jahannam jise mujrim jhoota jaante the.
ayahs.44: Is ke aur khaultay hue garam paani ke darmiyan chakkar khaayenge.
ayahs.45: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.46: Aur is shakhs ke liye jo apne Rabb ke saamne khada hone se dara do jannaten hain.
ayahs.47: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.48: (Dono jannaten) bahut si tehniyon aur shaakhon wali hain.
ayahs.49: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.50: Un dono (jannaton) mein do behte hue chashme hain.
ayahs.51: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.52: Un dono jannaton mein har qism ke mewon ki do qismein hongi.
ayahs.53: Phir tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.54: Jannati aise farshon par takiya lagaaye hue honge jin ke astar dabees resham ke honge, aur un dono jannaton ke meway bilkul qareeb honge.
ayahs.55: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.56: Wahan (sharmeeli) neechi nigaah wali hooren hain jinhein un se pehle kisi jinn-o-ins ne haath nahin lagaaya.
ayahs.57: Pas apne paalne wale ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.58: Woh hooren misl-e-yaaqoot aur moonge ke hongi.
ayahs.59: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.60: Ehsaan ka badla ehsaan ke siwa kya hai.
ayahs.61: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.62: Aur un ke siwa do jannaten aur hain.
ayahs.63: Pas tum apne parwarish karne wale ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.64: Jo dono gehri sabz siyaahi-maail hain.
ayahs.65: Bataao ab apne Parwardigaar ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.66: Un mein do (josh se) ubalne wale chashme hain.
ayahs.67: Phir tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.68: Un dono mein meway aur khajoor aur anaar honge.
ayahs.69: Kya ab bhi Rabb ki kisi ne'mat ki takzeeb tum karoge?
ayahs.70: Un mein nek seerat khoobsoorat auratein hain.
ayahs.71: Pas tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.72: (Gori rangat ki) hooren jannati khemon mein rehne waaliyan hain.
ayahs.73: Pas (ae insaano aur jinno!) Tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.74: Un ko haath nahin lagaaya kisi insaan ya jinn ne is se qabl.
ayahs.75: Pas apne Parwardigaar ki kaun kaun si ne'mat ke saath tum takzeeb karte ho?
ayahs.76: Sabz masnadon aur umda farshon par takiya lagaaye hue honge.
ayahs.77: Pas (ae jinno aur insaano!) Tum apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ko jhutlaaoge?
ayahs.78: Tere Parwardigaar ka naam ba-barkat hai jo izzat-o-jalaal wala hai.
